thread:
anna_support: FYI customer reported sudden 502/504 spike on Hosted API around 18:32 UTC. Multiple clients impacted, started after a large embeddings job. tagging @mike_sre @ryan_oncall

mike_sre: got it. do we have any x-request-id or trace ids from the customer? also which route/model?

anna_support: customer provided trace id `tr-9b3f`. route: /v1/embeddings, model: open-embed-xxl. sample curl they sent:

```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input": ["<very large payload...>"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
# response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# via: envoy/1.23.1
# x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 12045
```

anna_support: they say the payloads are chunked client-side but sometimes send ~2-3 minute streaming requests.

edgebot: ALERT: edge-gw-502-rate spike detected 1778889980 (rate 14/min) - top upstream: embedder-1 :heavy_exclamation_mark:

ryan_oncall: checking edge metrics now. seeing h2 stream counts spike, many long-lived streams from that customer IP. envoy logs show upstream timeout and rst_stream from upstream. suspect h2 connection pool exhaustion + idle/keepalive drift.

mike_sre: can you paste a snippet of envoy log lines for tr-9b3f? look for upstream reset reasons and ES details. also check upstream 503/504 vs 502 mapping.

anna_support: pasted minimal log below:

```
[2025-09-18T18:33:12Z] "POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1" 502 - "tr-9b3f" upstream_reset: connection_failure, upstream_host: embedder-1, bytes_sent: 0
[2025-09-18T18:33:45Z] "POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1" 504 - "tr-9b3f" upstream_response_time: 12000, upstream_attempts: 1
```

mike_sre: connection_failure indicates upstream closed or couldn't accept new stream. did embedder-1 OOM or hit max concurrent streams? request patterns?

julia_prod: embedder-1 pods show high http2 stream concurrency on worker threads, CPU at 95% on two pods. memory OK. logs show goroutine/backlog growth in accept loop. looks like too many long-lived streams monopolizing worker.

ryan_oncall: on edge side we have per-worker connection limit 1024 and per upstream pool 256 streams. with a few clients sending long lived streaming embed requests we can starve the pool for short requests -> 502 plumbing.

mike_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) apply per-route max-concurrent-streams and low idle_timeout on edge for embeddings route, 2) bump upstream pool size for embedder service, 3) recommend customers chunk or use batch windowing. which do we want first?

anna_support: customer is okay with short-term guidance. asked for repro steps from us so they can throttle. also want an ETA for a fix.

ryan_oncall: rolling a quick Envoy config change to reduce keepalive_idle_timeout from 2m -> 20s for /v1/embeddings and set `max_concurrent_streams: 64` per connection to prevent single clients hogging streams. applying to canary region now.

edgebot: DEPLOY: envoy-config-canary applied at 1778890025 by ryan_oncall :rocket:

mike_sre: monitoring impact. initial metrics show active streams down 60% on canary. error rate for that route down to baseline. good signal. we should also add rate-limited 413/429 guidance upstream to fail fast for huge single-request payloads.

julia_prod: parallel work: autoscale policy tweak on embedder-1 to spin additional pods on sustained h2 stream queues. patch in PR #4523 to increase target concurrency per pod.

anna_support: relayed canary success to the customer and asked them to shard/limit to smaller batches. they prefer a permanent platform fix.

mike_sre: next steps: 1) promote canary to prod after 30m observation (looks good), 2) add per-route streaming timeouts and backpressure docs for customers, 3) ops ticket to tune embedder autoscaling + consider connection preemption.

ryan_oncall: promoting now. prod push at 1778890120. will watch for regressions.

edgebot: PROMOTE: envoy-config-prod pushed at 1778890120 by ryan_oncall :white_check_mark:

anna_support: customer confirmed errors subsided after ~10m post-promotion, will adopt chunking in next deployment. they thanked support. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: filing a post-incident note and linking this thread to the embedder oncall runbook. recommend adding a telemetry alert for long-lived streams per client IP.

julia_prod: noted. I'll follow up with PR for autoscale and a small observability dashboard for h2 stream distribution.

anna_support: closing loop with customer. marking as resolved in ticketing. nice quick turnaround team. :tada:
